name: molten-metal

frames.best_why: Layered violet and white filaments fill the field with clear loops and bright hot spots.

tagline: Glowing purple filaments swirl across black like molten wire.
summary: A full-screen shader of slow-moving molten filaments in violet and white on black. The ribbons curl and brighten, drift toward the cursor, and flare where you click.
appearance: Thin luminous ribbons of violet and white twist across a near-black stage, looping into loose knots and glowing brightest at their bends. Much of the field stays deep black, so the strands read as hot wire in darkness.
behaviour: The filaments drift and fold slowly, their glow sliding along the curves. Moving the pointer nudges the flow, and clicking sends out a bright flare.
use_when: A hero or section wants a dark, dramatic glowing backdrop with a molten-metal feel.
avoid_when: A full-screen WebGL shader runs every frame, so it is heavy on phones and needs a sized parent.
customise: Colours, core colour, background, light mode, speed, scale, detail, glow, thickness, swirl, turbulence, brightness, colour mode, rotation, offset, drift, grain, opacity and mouse settings are props.
weight_why: A looping fragment shader with up to eight detail layers redraws every frame.

a11y.note: Decorative canvas with no roles or labels; reduced motion freezes the flow and disables the cursor trail and click flare.

issues: Frame 1 catches the reveal before the field forms, so it is almost entirely black.
polish_why: Elegant molten strands and deep blacks; the thin lines can read as too faint on bright screens.
title: Molten Metal
